name: mirage
text: Done: the parlay maker is now paper only (SHADOW): it still listens to every request and logs what it would quote and what the market paid, but sends nothing real. The 13 parlays already filled ($73 collateral) stay until their games settle. The 30-minute check-ins continue on the paper numbers (how many legs we can price, would-win rate, would-earn) and I keep working on pricing more legs. When you've added money tell me and I'll switch it back to live and raise the collateral cap.
